title: Admin Panel Meta-Schema
description: Defines the complete structure for generating an admin panel, including navigation, resources, views, actions, and data transformations.

panelName.description: The name displayed at the top of the admin panel.

navigation.description: The main navigation structure of the panel.

navigationItem.description: A top-level item in the navigation bar. Can be a group of resources or a user menu.

id.description: A unique identifier for the navigation group (e.g., 'lists').

title.description: The display title for the navigation group (e.g., 'LISTS').

id.description: The fixed identifier for the user menu.

title.description: The display title for the user menu (e.g., 'USER').

userMenuItem.description: An item within the user dropdown menu.

resource.description: Defines a data resource like 'Products' or 'Users' that can be managed via CRUD.

endpoint.description: Base API endpoint for this resource.

field.description: The key of the data field to display in this column.

header.description: The text to display in the column header.

field.description: The key of the data field to display.

label.description: The label for the data field.

action.description: A user-performable action. Can be one that requires complex input (form) or a simple one-click action.

target.description: 'global' appears on the list page, 'item' on a specific row/item.

endpoint.description: API endpoint for the action. Use {id} for item-specific targets.

formSchema.description: A standard JSON Schema and optional uiSchema for RJSF.

payloadTransform.description: A JSONata expression to transform UI form data into the API payload. If omitted, a 1:1 mapping is assumed.

dataMapTransform.description: A JSONata expression to map API data into the shape needed to populate the form for editing. If omitted, a 1:1 mapping is assumed.

target.description: 'none' is used for context-less actions like logout.

confirmationText.description: If present, a confirmation dialog with this text will be shown before executing.

targetResource.description: The 'id' of the resource to navigate to.

targetId.description: A variable representing the ID of the resource to view, e.g., '@currentUser'.
